hash: SHA-256; leaf = H(0x00||entry), node = H(0x01||left||right); empty root = H('')
entry_template: entry i = UTF-8 bytes of the string 'entry-{i}' (decimal i, no padding)
notes: inclusion verification takes the already-hashed leaf (leaf_hash)

negatives marked expect=reject are guaranteed to fail the RFC 9162 verification algorithms; wrong_size negatives only include sizes where the algorithm rejects (some wrong sizes are inherently accepted by the RFC algorithm because the verifier cannot see the right-hand structure)
truncated_proof_hash has an element of 31 bytes (malformed length)
